scope: First full-resolution occlusion-aware persistent-grasp adversarial audit
summary: The first audit was stopped without a quality decision because its exact mask distance expanded radii 0 through 24 independently on every frame and repeated the same work for the hand-erasure attack.
evidence: The process remained inside mask_chebyshev_distance after more than six minutes on a 660-frame 1280x720 candidate.
The interrupted stack trace identifies repeated binary_dilate_square calls as the bottleneck.
No audit report or acceptance result was emitted from the failed run directory.
lessons: Exact image-space distance should exploit monotonicity and be evaluated only on the declared hold interval.
An adversary that analytically erases the complete robot-hand support has zero bridge coverage and does not require a second distance transform.
limitations: This attempt contains no candidate quality result because it was stopped before completion.
next_actions: Use binary-search radius evaluation, restrict the new gate to frames 497-643, and rerun in a new directory with unchanged acceptance thresholds.
